title: The backup and read-record health checks say 'all fine' when their own record cannot be read
what: The outage watch asks HQ two questions: did last night's backup work, and is the direct-read record failing. If HQ cannot read its own stored answer for a moment, both say all is well. The backup check even overwrites the real record with 'just started, give it 30 hours', so a run of failed backups looks fresh until the next night, and the date of the last good copy is wiped. Only a server log line shows it.
expected: When the stored record cannot be read, the check answers 'unknown' so the watch raises an alarm, and the real record is never overwritten.
how_often: rare: only when the stored record cannot be read
fix_line: Answer 'unknown, alarm' instead of 'fine' when the record cannot be read, and never write over it then

title: After a gym server outage of over 15 minutes, 'please pay' notes and 'paid online' alerts from that time are lost for good
what: Every minute HQ looks back only 15 minutes for new desk fee requests and online payments and hands them on. If the gym server is down, or refuses, for longer than that, the requests and payments made in that gap fall out of the window and are never sent. The member never gets the 'please pay' note and the gym never gets 'Asha paid online'. The desk thinks the member was told. Only a server log line says each run failed, not which items were lost.
expected: Items that were not handed on stay waiting until they are, however long the outage lasts.
fix_line: Mark each request as handed once it is handed, and pick up every one not yet handed instead of only the last 15 minutes

evidence: data:filtered by script, 159 rows, not read (other silent.csv rows of server/hq-gate-workers; read: 21 silent catch rows and 67 fallback rows)
